scope: Artifact coverage and metadata/integrity validation only; independent visual conclusions supplied by root.
checksDescription: 34 exact state-file entries, no missing or unexpected state IDs.
Each state has closed/half/expanded/rotated; target and settled progress and 90-degree yaw checked with0.02 tolerance.

evidenceLimits: PNG integrity/pose metadata do not prove screenshot pixels show the intended model or visual correctness; root independently performed visual inspection.

Captured pixel dimensions are image dimensions, not a claim of CSS viewport or physical-device testing.
